title: Monotonicity for AI ethics and society: An empirical study of the monotonic neural additive model in criminology, education, health care, and finance
reasoning: The paper focuses on AI ethics and fairness by investigating monotonicity as a core principle. It references ethical frameworks, such as deontology and Immanuel Kant's philosophy, and evaluates moral concepts like forgiveness and justice in the context of high-stakes automated decision-making.
